{{Infobox auto}}
'''Fish bones''' are a [[fishing junk]] item. They are a {{MCW|Bone|bone}} with a different name and texture, so they work anywhere a bone does, for example crafting [[Bone Meal|bone meal]].

== Obtaining ==
=== Fishing ===
* 12.82% of junk in most biomes (10 of 78 weight), about 1.28% of all catches.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing/junk.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/misc/fish_bones.json}}</ref>
* 90.91% of the Sulfur Caves table, 41.77% of catches in Sulfur Caves.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing/sulfur_caves.json}}</ref>

Catching them plays their own [[fishing sounds|sound]].

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|1.12.3|Fish bones from Sulfur Caves now have the correct texture, so they stack with fish bones from the junk table.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing/sulfur_caves.json}}</ref> Junk fish bones come from their own loot table.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/misc/fish_bones.json}}</ref>}}
}}
